We'd like to say a huge thanks to the guys at Innovative Auto Kraft and Level Car Connection for helping with the cars for this video!
It’s America vs Italy in this quarter-mile drag race!
Mat’s lining up against the brand-new, twin-turbo hybrid Chevrolet Corvette ZR1X in the legendary plug-in hybrid Ferrari SF90 Stradale. On paper, this is an absolute heavyweight clash of hybrid hypercars - so let’s see how the stats stack up before they hit the runway!
